profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, traded under the ticker META with CIK 0001326801. Its developer site at llama.com describes building with Meta's AI models and tools, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site also describes search grounding, which gives a model live access to the web by adding a single tool to a request, and a quick start that points an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API.

Muse Image is offered on the Meta Model API at $0.01/image, described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing, with anchored composition for consistent edits. Llama (Meta) is listed as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. Financial filings report revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, on form 10-K.

Litigation naming the company includes Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. The litigation record counts 237 cases in California. MCP servers associated with Meta include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, described as a Meta Ads server with 47 tools for campaigns, creatives, audiences, and insights; co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp for Facebook and Meta Ads automation; com.adbloop/meta-ads for bulk-creating Facebook and Instagram ads across accounts from Drive folders; ai.fastmetal/fastmetal for running and comparing LLMs and generating images and video; ai.livingmeta/ai-in-research, a read-only server over a corpus of 12,400 papers; ai.primeta/primeta for 3D avatars with custom personas; and app.metadock/metadock for controlling a desktop workspace.
